newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar stocks steady in subdued Ramadan trade.
newsitem.headline: Qatar stocks steady in subdued Ramadan trade.

text.p: Trade on the unofficial Qatar stock market was subdued in the week to Thursday with the start of the Islamic month of Ramadan keeping investors away, brokers said.
"The week saw mixed results amid slow activity," said Mazin al-Shakarchi, assistant general manager of treasury and investments at the Commercial Bank of Qatar (CBQ).
Four shares advanced, one fell and 13 remained unchanged.
The CBQ's 18-share index edged up fractionally to 126.89 points from 126.57 the previous week.
Market leader Qatar National Bank rose five riyals to 635 and Qatar General Insurance added another five riyals to close at 600.
Al Khaleej Insurance and Qatar Cement advanced two riyals each to 300 and 320 respectively.
Qatar Shipping shed half a riyal to 48.
Brokers expect trading volumes to remain subdued until the end of Ramadan.
